context:
Goal: every ruling you give is kept, wherever you type it, and nothing a session writes is logged as yours.
Problem (goal): the lane took this undoable pick today without asking you: a relayed message arrives looking exactly like a peer session's message, so the feedback log cannot tell your relayed words from a session's own.
Based on (ruling): R27 point 4 asks for relayed words to be saved; R12 counts a relay only once a check against the sender's own log is built, and that check is not built yet.
Departs from: main has no feedback log — PR #2996 adds one that saves your typed words and question-box answers only.

options.gain: Nothing a session writes can be logged as your word.
options.how: PR #2996 as built: only your typed words and question-box answers are logged; relays wait for the sender check. Undo: pick b later.
options.label: Keep relays unlogged for now (Recommended)
options.lose: A ruling you give in another session's chat is missing from this log until the check is built.

options.gain: Relayed rulings are kept from today.
options.how: The relaying session adds a marker line with your exact words and their time, and the log saves marked lines now.
options.label: Log relays that carry a marker
options.lose: Until the sender check is built, a session that writes the marker wrongly puts words in the log as yours.

reply: Closed 00:51 CST Nov 13 by triage: you picked b (log relays that carry a marker). Sent to lane prose-tending-contract.
title: Your words relayed by another session stay out of the feedback log for now
why: The lane took this pick; it stands unless you choose b.
